internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: In both our Mosta and Pama branches, we offer daily eye testing with a choice of the full spectrum of eyecare practitioners available, from Consultant Ophthalmologists to Optometrists and Orthoptists.

Eyeland was set up in 2002 by the second generation of an optical family business, to provide the full range of optical services and offer the latest eyewear and the most technologically advanced optical lenses and contact lenses available. In 2015 we opened our second branch at Pama Shopping Village.

network.coverage_note: The institution is a commercial optician business and does not have any Erasmus+ or international mobility programs or partners. No contact persons are listed on the website.
